title: Registrar's Reference: Registration Documents, Deadlines and Withdrawal Signatures
content:
This reference lists, for each enrollment type of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, which registration documents the type requires, the calendar-day deadlines that apply to them, and who signs a withdrawal and which date it takes.

## Residency proof

| Enrollment type | Proof of residency dated within the last 60 days must be on file for the school year | Calendar days after the registration date (day 0) within which a provisional registration must establish residency | Residency re-verified for every school year |
|---|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | yes | 30 | yes |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | yes | 30 | yes |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | no | 30 | no |
| Non-Resident Transfer | no | 30 | no |
| Choice Program Enrollment | yes | 30 | yes |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | yes | 30 | yes |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | yes | 30 | yes |

## Identity and immunization records

| Enrollment type | Calendar days after the entry date within which a certified birth certificate or other proof of identity must be on file | Calendar days a student transferring from another Texas public school may attend provisionally while immunization records are obtained |
|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | 30 | 30 |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | 30 | 30 |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | 30 | 30 |
| Non-Resident Transfer | 30 | 30 |
| Choice Program Enrollment | 30 | 30 |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | 30 | 30 |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | 30 | 30 |

## Withdrawal

| Enrollment type | Who may sign the district withdrawal form | Date a withdrawal takes |
|---|---|---|
| Attendance Zone Enrollment | the parent or guardian of record | the last day of attendance |
| Intra-District Transfer (Space Available) | the parent or guardian of record | the last day of attendance |
| Intra-District Transfer (Employee Child) | the parent or guardian of record | the last day of attendance |
| Non-Resident Transfer | the parent or guardian of record | the last day of attendance |
| Choice Program Enrollment | the parent or guardian of record | the last day of attendance |
| Pre-Kindergarten (State-Eligible) | the parent or guardian of record | the last day of attendance |
| Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based) | the parent or guardian of record | the last day of attendance |

## Counting the residency deadline (hypothetical dates)

A provisional registration submitted on a hypothetical 4 March has 4 March as day 0; day 30 is 3 April. Residency established on 3 April is within the deadline; on 4 April it is not.
